       'c':c_,'s':s_,'xc':x*c_,'xs':x*s_,'vc':v*c_,'vs':v*s_,'x2c':x*x*c_,'x2s':x*x*s_,'cosxc':np.cos(x)*c_,'cosxs':np.cos(x)*s_,'sinxc':np.sin(x)*c_,'sinxs':np.sin(x)*s_,'c2':np.cos(2*w*t),'s2':np.sin(2*w*t),'tc':t*c_,'ts':t*s_,'t':t,'tv':t*v,'tx':t*x}
    names=list(D); M=np.column_stack([D[k] for k in names])
    sel=[];

        best=None

            if j in sel: continue
            A=M[:,sel+[j]]
